# UV Print Shop

> UV Print Shop is a specialized printing company based in the Netherlands, offering professional UV and 3D printing services and custom material cutting solutions. We combine cutting-edge UV and 3D printing technology with precision material cutting to deliver high-quality, durable results for both businesses and individuals.

## Services

### UV Printing
- High-quality UV printing on various materials
- Custom designs and prints
- Professional-grade equipment and techniques
- Suitable for both personal and business projects
- Learn more: https://uvprintshop.nl/uv-printing

### Material Cutting (Op Maat Snijden)
- Precision cutting services for various materials
- Custom dimensions and specifications
- Professional cutting equipment
- Wide range of materials supported
- Details: https://uvprintshop.nl/op-maat-snijden

### Photo on Wood (Foto op Hout)
- Custom photo printing on wooden surfaces
- High-quality image reproduction
- Durable and long-lasting results
- Perfect for personalized gifts and decorations
- View service: https://uvprintshop.nl/foto-op-hout

### Maquette Building (Maquette Bouw)
- Professional scale model construction
- Architectural and design maquettes
- Custom specifications and requirements
- High attention to detail and precision
- More info: https://uvprintshop.nl/maquette-bouw

### QR Code Services
- Custom QR code generation and printing
- Various formats and materials
- Business and personal applications
- Integration with marketing materials
- QR services: https://uvprintshop.nl/qr-codes

## Materials Guide

UV Print Shop offers 11+ premium materials for UV printing and laser engraving, each optimized for specific applications:

### Available Materials

**Wood (Hout)** - Natural & warm aesthetic for indoor use. FSC-certified, UV-resistant print, 6-18mm thickness. Perfect for wall decoration, gifts, and retail signage. €€

**Aluminum** - Modern & durable for indoor/outdoor. Lightweight, corrosion-resistant, 100% recyclable, 1-3mm thickness. Ideal for business signage, door plates, and design applications. €€€ (Min. 10 pieces for laser cutting)

**Stainless Steel (RVS)** - Premium & rust-proof for extreme durability. Perfect for medical, food service, maritime, and industrial use. Hygienic and indestructible. €€€€ (Min. 10 pieces)

**Acrylic (Plexiglas)** - Elegant & transparent glass alternative. Lighter and safer than glass, UV-resistant, 3-10mm. Great for art, photography, retail displays, and interior design. €€€

**Forex (PVC Foam)** - Budget-friendly & lightweight for temporary use. Very light, easy to install, 3-10mm. Excellent for promotions, events, and temporary signage. €

**Dibond (Aluminum Composite)** - Professional & flat for large formats. Extremely flat surface, weather-resistant, 3mm. Perfect for facade panels, photography, and exhibitions. €€€

**Trespa® / HPL** - Indestructible & vandal-resistant. Waterproof, maintenance-free, fire-retardant, 6mm. Ultimate choice for outdoor signage and extreme conditions. €€€€

**Akrylite® (Honeycomb)** - Ultra-lightweight & eco-friendly. Only 600g/m², fully recyclable, weather-resistant. Great for POS materials and sustainable projects. €

**Polystyrene** - Strong & flame-retardant. Solid material, double-sided printable, suitable for humid spaces. Ideal for illuminated displays and wayfinding. €€

**SanoTex (Wall Covering)** - Seamless & PVC-free wallpaper. Up to 4.94x20m seamless, 100% recyclable. Perfect for offices, retail, and events. €€

**DecoTex (Polyester Fabric)** - Premium textile with wrinkle-recovery. Up to 496cm wide, matte finish, 200g/m². Excellent for trade shows and hospitality. €€

### Quick Selection Guide

- **Outdoor permanent**: Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Dibond, Trespa®
- **Indoor decoration**: Wood, Acrylic, Dibond
- **Budget/Temporary**: Forex, Akrylite®
- **Food/Medical**: Stainless Steel
- **Large formats**: Dibond, Trespa®, SanoTex
- **Eco-friendly**: Wood (FSC), Aluminum, Akrylite®

**Complete Materials Guide**: https://uvprintshop.nl/materialen-gids
